name: Lateral Medicine Ball Slam
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Rotate away from the wall, then explosively rotate and throw the ball into the wall.
Catch the rebound and immediately reload.
Alternate sides each set. Builds rotational power for sports.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: An intermediate minimal equipment core exercise for the abs. Lateral Medicine Ball Slam builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
